_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 15:36 ET BY THE PRE-CLOSE RUN AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled - unchanged from the 15:22 read because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 15:36 and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so THE BOARD GOES INTO THE BELL FLAT AND NO OVERNIGHT HOLD EXISTS TO BE DECIDED: no target, no stop, no time stop, no option no-fly window closing today, and no straddle owed because item 3 binds only before an earnings hold. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so nothing was executed today and agentTrades stays 0. NOTHING SURVIVES THE BELL AND THERE IS NOTHING TO EXPIRE: the only will entry dated today was the 09:47 TGT entry at 159.36, withdrawn by appending at 14:22, so no unexpired specification remains, no limit is resting into the close, and nothing can become tomorrow's order. THE FINDING OF THIS RUN IS THAT THE LAST HOUR'S FINDING REVERSED. The 15:22 run reported against its own interest that the withdrawn 159.36 level had printed seven bars from 14:35 to 15:09 and that a fill would be 0.30 a share in front - sixty cents across two shares. TGT is now 159.05 bid / 159.14 ask at 19:36:32.341Z, last 159.06, a 0.09 spread or 0.057% of mark and +0.03% against the 159.00 close, having given back 0.61 in fourteen minutes. A 2-share fill at 159.36 would be SIXTY-TWO CENTS UNDERWATER instead, and carried overnight. That is a 1.22 swing across two shares inside a quarter of an hour, and it is recorded as evidence that the cost of the drought test is not a number any single hour can price - not as a vindication of it. The open question stands for the retro: the test fired fifty minutes before the tape came back, and whether an hour is the right length is a process question today's sign flip does not answer.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares and WITHDRAWN at 14:22 on a test written two hours before it fired
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD AND STAYING DEAD, AND THE ARITHMETIC OF THE KILL REVERSED INSIDE FOURTEEN MINUTES. TGT is 159.05 bid / 159.14 ask at 19:36:32.341Z, last 159.06, a 0.09 spread or 0.057% of mark - the tightest quote of the session - and +0.03% against the 159.00 settled close, having given back 0.61 from the 159.66 bid of the 15:22 check and essentially the whole day with it. The withdrawn 159.36 limit now sits 0.31 ABOVE the bid and 0.22 above the OFFER, so it is marketable again - and a 2-share fill there would be SIXTY-TWO CENTS UNDERWATER rather than the sixty cents in front the 15:22 run measured. The 15:30 specification ceiling passed before this run quoted anything, so it could not be re-struck in any case.
entryWatch.why: THE SIXTY-CENT COST BECAME A SIXTY-TWO-CENT SAVING AND NEITHER NUMBER IS THE POINT. The 15:22 run wrote down, in full and against its own interest, that the pre-committed drought test had cost this board sixty cents - seven bars from 14:35 to 15:09 traded at or below 159.36, the lowest 0.43 through it, and a resting 2-share bid would have filled outright. Fourteen minutes later the same tape has made the same test look right, and it did so without a single new fact about TGT arriving. THAT IS THE FINDING, AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF A VINDICATION. A test whose measured cost swings 1.22 across two shares in a quarter of an hour has not been graded by today at all - it has been priced twice, at random, by whichever run happened to read the tape. The question the 15:22 run handed to the retro, whether an hour-long drought is the right length when it fired fifty minutes before the level came back, is exactly as open as it was, and it must be answered on the process rather than on a P/L this unstable. IT IS STILL NOT REVIVED. Re-issuing a withdrawn level because the price came back is the mirror image of raising a limit to chase, and it would mean the test binds only when honouring it is free. Tomorrow's open may write TGT again on tomorrow's quotes. It may not revive 159.36.

entryWatch.setup: SQM post-earnings day-2 continuation off a 13% beat with a deliberately tepid day-1 reaction - ranked second today and passed over on liquidity
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 15:36 AND THE PASSED-OVER NAME HAS WON THE DAY OUTRIGHT. SQM is 78.00 bid / 78.13 ask at 19:36:31.034Z, last 78.038, +3.48% against the 75.38 settled close, against TGT's +0.03% on the same tape. That is 3.45 points of relative performance against 2.26 an hour ago - the widest gap recorded at any check today, and it widened because TGT gave the day back rather than because SQM added to it. The 0.13 spread is 0.167% of mark, tighter than the 0.193% of an hour ago but still nearly three times TGT's 0.057%, which is the liquidity gap it was ranked second on.
entryWatch.why: SIX OF SEVEN HOURLY CHECKS NOW RECORD THE PASSED-OVER NAME BEATING THE CHOSEN ONE, AND THE LAST ONE IS THE WIDEST. That goes at the top of the row rather than buried in it, because a ranking that reports only its flattering hours is not a record. THE PROCESS HALF IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT REVISED BY THE OUTCOME. SQM was passed over on item 4 with 51,087 shares in fifteen minutes against a 896,905 average, and no amount of relative performance repairs a thin book. Item 2 refuses it independently and refused it at every single reading today: a name up 3.48% on day 2, quoted 1.73 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, is being bought after the move rather than on the reclaim - and this slot may not open anything in the last thirty minutes regardless. The ranking is graded at the close on outcome and on process separately, so the retro can say the choice was wrong on the day without concluding the rule was wrong.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE REFUSAL IS 1.27 IN THE MONEY AT A SESSION LOW INTO THE BELL. AS is 32.58 bid / 32.60 ask at 19:36:28.664Z, last 32.59, -4.23% against the 34.02 settled close and sitting at the bottom of its range rather than recovering into the close. That is 1.12 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance and 1.27 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted.
entryWatch.why: THE REFUSAL TO REVIVE A DEAD LEVEL IS NOW 1.27 IN THE MONEY, AND THE PREVIOUS TWO HOURS ARE THE REASON THAT SENTENCE IS WORTH ANYTHING. When the bounce was running this row said the answer does not change with the duration of a bounce any more than with its direction, and that two consecutive hours of recovery is exactly when a revival starts to look like judgement and gets a thesis written for it after the fact. It then rolled over. Had this board revived 33.87 at the top of that bounce the position would be 1.27 underwater instead of 0.92. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke at 33.70 and nothing since has rebuilt it. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back toward it after the structure broke. TODAY'S TGT KILL IS THE SAME RULE POINTED THE OTHER WAY and the two belong on the board together: this row refuses a level the tape came back to, and the TGT row refuses to keep a level alive because the tape came back to it. Both are the board declining to let subsequent price action rewrite a decision it already made in writing.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTY-FOURTH TIME. SMCI is 36.64 bid / 36.65 ask at 19:36:33.184Z, last 36.645, +0.16% against the 36.58 settled close - green into the bell after a session spent oscillating around its own close. The dead 38.24 limit is 1.59 ABOVE the offer, against 1.66 an hour ago and 0.78 BELOW it five hours ago. Best spread on the board at 0.027%.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND FOUR HOURS HAVE NOW SUPPLIED THE PROOF IN EVERY DIRECTION. At 10:24 this row refused a price 0.78 through the dead limit; by 12:22 that price had evaporated and the name was 2.41% red; at 13:23 it was 1.72% red and bouncing; now it is flat. Up, down, up, flat - and none of it repairs a missing catalyst. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5 - no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet - and SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone, on the tightest quote here at 0.027%.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 15:36 AND STILL WITHOUT A BASE INTO THE BELL. KLAR is 13.89 bid / 13.90 ask at 19:36:27.422Z, last 13.90, -5.70% against the 14.73 settled close and 0.11 BELOW the 14.00 of the last check - the single upward hourly print of the day has already been given back. It closes a third consecutive down session 0.43 through the 14.32 level this row carried, and a third red day that ends on its lows is not a base.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND TODAY IT ALSO DOCUMENTS THE LIMIT OF ITEM 1 ON THE NAME THIS BOARD ACTUALLY BOUGHT. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -4.2% today and KLAR is -5.0% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. WMT beat this morning and sold off nearly nine percent, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company. TGT's beat is the one that paid - and it still could not fill an entry struck 0.24% under where the stock now trades, which is a different failure from the one this row illustrates and is worth having both on the same board.

candidatesNote: Twenty-four names, every row a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. Twelve carried-forward and day-2 names were quoted in one call at 13:42:2x-13:42:3xZ and twelve fresh 8/19-after and 8/20-before reporters in a second call at 13:42:5x-13:43:0xZ. TGT, SQM and AS were RE-QUOTED at 13:47:1xZ when the limit was struck and those numbers are the ones on their rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: every name on the live 8/19-8/20 calendar with a tradeable quote is priced here, including the four beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 158.07 bid at 13:42:28Z and RE-QUOTED 158.82 bid / 159.36 ask at 13:47:11Z, +0.06% against the 159.00 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares, the third consecutive not-forced entry. 104.48 bid, -8.59% on an 0.81 against 0.74 BEAT - a 9.5% beat sold off nearly nine percent. The single loudest illustration of item 5 this board has recorded, and the reason item 5 is not a formality on TGT. Not a candidate: buying the down half of a print is not a setup here, and this is day 1 of a collapse rather than a base.
44.55 bid, -20.70% on a 1.03 against 0.81 BEAT - a 27% beat that lost a fifth of the company in one session. Second of today's sold beats and the more extreme. Not a candidate at any price today.

REFUSED MECHANICALLY BEFORE ANY VIEW IS FORMED: one share is 59.5% of the account against a 40% single-name ceiling, so there is no size at which it can be owned.
